subject: ist-s-algn
title: (R)IST.S.ALGN.------INFO.CON.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 171 (SR(TRS)II-27). IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; INFO-CON (information convergence) is the partner. From the subject: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From SPT-DY: AFN (affinity negation). From AF-DY: AFI1 (affinity insight—first degree). From AFN: PRI-INFO (principle information) and VT-PLT (vibrational platform), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From AFI1: PR-TR. From VT-PLT: EXTN-D (existential definition). From PR-TR: EXT-DY (extended dynamics).
